page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.i2gne.8xlarge is a storage-optimized instance within the Local SSDs family, designed for high-throughput, I/O-intensive workloads. It is powered by an Intel Xeon 8163 processor built on x86_64 architecture, operating at a base clock frequency of 2.5 GHz. The instance provisions 32 dedicated vCPUs mapped across 16 physical cores with hyper-threading enabled. Memory capacity totals 128.0 GB of RAM, adhering to a 1:4 vCPU-to-memory allocation of 4.0 GB per core. The hardware cache includes 32 KB L1 data cache per core, 1.0 MB L2 cache, and a shared 33 MB L3 cache, with hardware support for AVX and AVX-512 extensions.

Storage configuration consists of 3839 GB of bundled local SSD storage, eliminating the need to rely exclusively on remote block storage for high-frequency I/O operations. Network connectivity is rated at a baseline bandwidth of 10 Gbps. The instance operates without discrete GPU acceleration. In synthetic benchmark testing, the Intel Xeon 8163 processor delivers middle-tier multi-threaded output, scoring 23527.36 in stress-ng multi-core and 8507.0 in Geekbench multi-core. Single-threaded metrics are lower, recording 966.0 in Geekbench single-core and 1108.99 in stress-ng single-core, reflecting the constraints of older microarchitectures.

Data handling performance remains steady in multi-threaded workflows, yielding 105.59 GB/sec in multi-threaded bzip3 decompression and 22.82 million operations per second in Redis SET operations. Static web serving throughput reaches 14.06 GB/sec. Uncached large-block read memory bandwidth achieves 99.37 GB/sec, while uncached write operations measure 43.49 GB/sec. For lightweight AI tasks, prompt processing reaches 1378.81 tokens per second on a 135M model and 40.34 tokens per second on a 7B model.

The qualitative cost profile favors storage-centric applications where large local SSD capacity and moderate parallel processing negate external storage overheads. The instance is suited for relational and NoSQL databases, caching layers, log processing, and distributed data systems that prioritize fast local disk access over peak single-core CPU frequency.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.i2gne.8xlarge is a storage-optimized instance featuring 32 dedicated vCPUs across 16 physical cores on an Intel Xeon 8163 processor running at 2.5 GHz. Configured with 128.0 GB of system memory, it maintains a balanced 1:4 core-to-RAM ratio alongside 3839 GB of integrated local SSD storage and a 10 Gbps network baseline. While single-thread benchmarks place the processor in lower percentiles (Geekbench single-core score of 966.0), multi-core capability delivers balanced output, verified by a PassMark CPU score of 23107.95 and Redis SET throughput of 22.82 million operations per second. Lacking hardware GPU accelerators, the instance directs resources toward high-throughput data processing and local disk I/O. The ecs.i2gne.8xlarge fits production databases, Redis caches, log aggregation platforms, and large-scale analytical processing requiring fast local storage access.
